content:
Last week's limited-time deal on AirPods Pro 3 at nearly 25% off is still available and could end at any moment; we also noticed the matte black Beats Solo Buds dropping to as low as $41. But today's headliner in 9to5Toys Lunch Break is the Apple official refurbished store offering up to $300 off the most affordable M5 MacBook Pro, alongside up to $100 off select new Apple Watch Series 11 models, plus rare discounts on Apple Sport Bands and Loops. After that, we'll take you through the all-time low prices on Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand and the 45W Nano smart display charger, along with Best Buy's updated back-to-school deals. See everything below right now.

Amazon's near-25%-off discount on AirPods Pro 3 is still live and could snap back at any time

Last week's Apple shopping festival brought one of the best AirPods Pro 3 deals we've seen yet. The matching offer at Best Buy for the Pro 3 discount has ended, with the retailer instead updating its 2026 Black to School promotions, but Amazon's near-25%-off AirPods Pro 3 discount remains active… for now.

Amazon is still selling Apple's latest AirPods Pro 3 for $189.99 with free shipping.

Originally priced at $249, it's now just a hair away from 25% off — about $10 cheaper than the July Black Friday deal, making it one of the lowest prices we've tracked since launch.

Best Buy's price already snapped back to $200 earlier this morning. This has recently been a useful indicator of Amazon's pricing direction — meaning the extra discount on Amazon could revert at any moment. If you've been waiting to grab a pair this week, now is the time to click. It wouldn't be at all surprising if Amazon adjusts its price back up to match Best Buy's level this morning.

We've only seen prices go lower than this on two very brief occasions — a $184 deal back in February and the more recent Prime Day blowout in June. Both of those deals have been long gone, and there's a good chance we won't see anything better than this before the fall sales season. Apple may also be unveiling the next generation next month, potentially adding cameras and pushing the price even higher.

  • AirPods Pro 3 – $190 (orig. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 – $449 (orig. $549)
  • AirPods 4 – $99 (orig. $129)
  • AirPods 4 (with ANC) – $119 (orig. $179 new) — Renewed Premium

Apple's official refurbished store offers up to $300 off the most affordable M5 MacBook Pro

We're still seeing up to $500 off the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, but discounts on the entry-level M5 lineup have been harder to come by. However, Apple's official refurbished store is offering an attractive deal: the most affordable M5 MacBook Pro still available, with 16GB/1TB specs, is $300 off its original price.

Apple's official certified refurbished store is now selling the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB RAM and 1TB SSD for $1,699 with free shipping.

Originally priced at $1,999, you can now buy it directly from an official source, backed by a full 1-year Apple warranty, and save $300.

For comparison — and to underscore the point above — Amazon currently sells this model brand-new for $1,849. Since official retailers hiked prices at the end of June, it hasn't dipped below that on Amazon.

Even though it's refurbished, we're talking about the most reliable source for refurbished MacBooks, and it is very likely one of the lowest prices you'll find online from a reputable seller for the most affordable current-generation M5 MacBook Pro that Apple still sells.

Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand drops back to its Prime Day all-time low (35% off)

After getting hands-on time with this model earlier this year, the Anker 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger has become a staple in my EDC, travel kit, and home charging setup. Now at nearly 35% off, we have another shot at grabbing it at the lowest price Amazon has tracked.

Anker's official Amazon store is now selling its latest 25W 3-in-1 Prime foldable MagSafe charger for $99.97 with free shipping.

Originally $150, this 3-in-1 charging device — featuring a MagSafe pad with up to 25W output — is now nearly 35% off in both the Phantom Gray/Black and Radiant White variants.

This week's deal matches what we mentioned earlier, lining up with Anker's big summer sale discounts and the prices seen during this year's Prime Day.

Although it's a compact, easily portable device, it has enough weight to sit steadily on your desk or nightstand, working equally well on a home workstation or on the go.

You can use the main MagSafe pad while it's folded up, but once you open it, a pop-out Apple Watch charger and a third Qi pad designed for AirPods are revealed, letting you charge your entire setup at once.

  • 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger with 25W Qi2
  • Active cooling "cicada wing" biomimetic airflow channels, operating at "just 19 decibels — quiet as a whisper"
  • Combined 25W output across three devices: iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods
  • Qi2 certified with MagSafe magnetic alignment • Supports iPhone 17, 16, 15, and 14 series
  • iPhone: up to 25W wireless charging
  • Dimensions (3.74 × 2.38 × 1.22 inches), weight matching the iPhone 17 Pro Max (8.11 oz)
  • In the box: Anker Prime wireless charging station (3-in-1, MagGo, AirCool, foldable), 45W USB-C charger, 5ft USB-C to USB-C cable, 2 anti-slip stickers, welcome guide, 24-month warranty

For more details, check out my unboxing review.

The most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 models are back to $100 off, starting at $299

Amazon is extending its summer AirPods Pro 3 sale into August alongside an all-time low on AirTag 2, but it's also relaunching up to $100 off nearly all of the most popular (and most affordable) Apple Watch Series 11 models, with deals starting from $299.

Amazon is once again taking $300 off all base GPS Apple Watch Series 11 models — the 42mm for $299, and the 46mm for $329.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 – $299 (orig. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 – $329 (orig. $429)

These match the deals we tracked during the summer Prime Day event, and they popped up a few times in July too — now you've got another shot. As of writing, only the base GPS models have meaningful discounts — the GPS + Cellular versions do have some deals, but most haven't dropped low enough to be worth pulling the trigger.

Looks like Amazon is currently running low on stock for the basic 42mm Jet Black, but there's a good chance it'll be restocked soon — all 46mm colorways are still available, each $100 off.

Rare discount knocks Apple Sport Bands and Loops down 20% on Amazon this week

Grab matte black Beats Solo Buds for as low as $41 right now

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Anker 5-port Nano travel adapter keeping you powered in "over 200 countries," down to $20
  • Rare deal drops Belkin's latest UltraCharge 2-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger to $54 (all colors)
  • Sharge Mini portable charger with star-track LED now down to $35 (orig. $50)
  • This DOCKCASE SSD enclosure displays drive health and features power-loss protection — now just $30 (all-time low)
  • Skip Apple's premium pricing and grab the LG UltraFine 6K Thunderbolt 5 monitor while it's $2,200 cheaper than the Studio Display XDR (new low)
  • Nothing Headphone (a) discounted further: all colors from $159, more from $69
  • Nothing launches new CMF Clip Pro open-ear earbuds, first-sale deal from $79
  • Latest Beats 240W braided USB-C cable (black) drops back to $18, free shipping for Prime members, all-time low (40% off)
  • Anker 7-in-1 smart display Nano charging station with retractable USB-C, down to $60

Best Buy updates 2026 back-to-school deals: TVs under $500, Bose up to $130 off, Apple products, Ninja kitchen appliances, and more

Anker 2026 back-to-school sale drops chargers, power banks, and Qi2.2 gear back to Prime Day lows, from $10 (46% off)

Anker is now running a back-to-school promotion across its accessory lineup, with promo code SCHOOL20 offering 20% off sitewide, covering chargers, power banks, cables, charging stations, and more. The brand's official Amazon store is also participating with multiple deals, plus extra discounts on several popular models. From compact Nano chargers and multi-port laptop chargers to MagSafe charging gear, power banks, and other everyday accessories, everything is discounted. Many of Amazon's deals bring prices back to the all-time lows we tracked during the recent Prime Day, giving you another chance to grab these best prices without waiting for the next big shopping festival. Whether you're kitting out for a new school or work setup, or just want to refresh your charging gear, there are plenty of Anker deals worth checking out right now.

Anker 2026 back-to-school sale is now live

The brand's official Amazon store has added a range of new deals, which we've highlighted below, alongside some existing offers for reference.

  • Anker 45W Nano charger with smart display – $26 (orig. $40)
  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger – $100 (orig. $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 charging station with display – $135 (orig. $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-port Prime charger with display and touch controls – $116 (orig. $150)
  • Anker 140W 4-port laptop charger with display – $65 (orig. $90)
  • Anker 25,000mAh 165W laptop power bank with dual USB-C cables – $105 (orig. $120)
  • Anker Nano 13-in-1 dock with detachable 6-in-1 hub – $112 (orig. $150)
  • Anker MagGo UFO 3-in-1 charging station – $72 (orig. $90)
  • Anker Nano ultra-slim 5,000mAh MagSafe power bank – $44 (orig. $55)
  • Code: SCHOOL20
  • And more…

One of the highlights of this sale is Anker's latest 45W Nano USB-C charger with a smart display dropping back to $25.99 with free shipping. Originally $40, today's deal takes $16 off, matching the all-time low we saw during the recent Prime Day. That's around 35% off — even better than the deals we've tracked directly at Anker. This is one of Anker's newer compact chargers, and all colors are now at the same $25.99 low price. The built-in smart display can identify supported iPhone models, optimize charging for safer power delivery, and show useful charging info, plus a few fun animations. It delivers up to 45W via a single USB-C port, and the foldable prongs keep the whole unit compact for travel, tech bag storage, or everyday carry.
